name: Ising Resonance Formulation
description: Replaced the boolean set logic (positive/negative dependencies and subsets) with an algebraic energy minimization condition where variables take values in {-1, 1}. A clause is violated only if a linear combination reaches its theoretical minimum. This completely hides the boolean operators and standard CNF literal mappings that LLMs rely on to pattern-match 2-SAT, forcing them to algebraically deduce the implication graph.
